evidence.description:
Every company is built on something. A shortage. A habit. A gamble. Most of the time, it is built on you.

Built On You tells the complete history of the world's biggest companies in a single sitting, from the founder's first strange idea to the empire, the scandals and the market cap they carry today. Amazon, IKEA, Walmart, McDonald's, Stripe, Coca-Cola, Nike, Toyota and more, told in order, with real dates, real numbers and the ordinary people history forgot.

No hype and no get-rich-quick lessons. Just the full story of how a garage, a farm shed or a single burger stand became something billions of people use without thinking about it, and what it was really built on.

Company history documentaries • Founder origin stories • Brand history • Corporate history explained
